allow: Bash(powershell -Command "Get-Process | Where-Object { $_ProcessName -like ''*python*'' -or $_ProcessName -like ''*node*'' -or $_ProcessName -like ''*uvicorn*'' } | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, Path")
Bash(cmd.exe /c "wmic process get ProcessId,Name,CommandLine /format:list | findstr /i python")
Bash(powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ""Name=''python.exe''"" | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine | Format-List")
